facts.text: Çiftleşme mevsiminde erkeğin başında mavi boynuzlar ve gıdı büyüyor.

en.title: This Bird Grows Blue Horns. Can You Name It?
en.description: The satyr tragopan, a Himalayan pheasant, grows blue horns and a wattle in the breeding season, inflating them to display to females. It lives up to 4,200 m in summer.
